description: Initial research software snapshot accompanying Horizon-Adaptive Battery Capacity Forecasting and Driver-Aware Stress Modelling from Electric-Vehicle Field Data. Includes source, notebooks, synthetic tests, supplied figures and selected aggregate result tables. Raw third-party data and model checkpoints are not included. See the documented dataset-specific scientific boundaries, missing locked 30-day targets, incomplete measurement-uncertainty audit, and sparse future thermal labels. This software record does not assert a calibrated pack degradation law or universal KAN superiority.
